# A lily pad with a lotus flower at its back edge (the frog lands on the front half). Up Z.
new
add mesh cylinder --name Pad --vertices 10 --radius 0.6 --depth 0.07 --cap-fill triangle-fan --location 0 0 0.035 --rotation 0 0 18
apply --rotation
mode edit
select face where "pos.x > 0.15 && abs(pos.y) < 0.12"
delete face
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete face
mode object
material new Pad --base-color 0.145 0.443 0.475
material assign Pad
# the flower: two crowns of petals (6-sided cones, the outer one turned) and a yellow heart
add mesh cone --name PetalsOut --vertices 6 --radius1 0.24 --radius2 0.06 --depth 0.18 --location -0.22 0.22 0.16
add mesh cone --name PetalsIn --vertices 6 --radius1 0.15 --radius2 0.03 --depth 0.24 --location -0.22 0.22 0.2 --rotation 0 0 30
material new Petal --base-color 0.937 0.490 0.341
select PetalsOut PetalsIn
material assign Petal
add mesh ico-sphere --name Heart --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.07 --location -0.22 0.22 0.3
material new Heart --base-color 1.0 0.804 0.459
material assign Heart
select all
shade flat
export lotus.glb
